description:
List the graph artifact tags on a graph and the artifact each tag points to: the artifact's ID, digest, status, creation time, and variant.
GraphOS Router can fetch an artifact by tag name instead of by digest.
It is similar to `rover graph-artifact list-tags`, which filters by artifact digest instead of variant.
Use it to find a tag or a digest before you call GetGraphArtifact, TagGraphArtifact, or UntagGraphArtifact.
Provide the graph ID.
Optionally filter by variant name, and page with first (at most 20) and after.

after.description: The cursor to start pagination after (for forward pagination)

first.description: The number of tags to return (for forward pagination), defaults to 10, maximum is 20

graphId.description: The ID of the graph where the tags reside

variant.description: The optional graph variant name, used to filter the results to a single variant

name: GetGraphArtifactTags
